[[File:Jagd.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Party enters jagd in ''Final Fantasy XII''.]]
{{Quote|So, when you're in jagd, skystones don't work at all. That's why we gotta hoof it the rest of the way, ya see?|Vaan to Penelo}}
A '''jagd''' {{j|ヤクト|yakuto}} is a piece of land that works outside the norms of [[Ivalice]] in ''[[Final Fantasy XII]]'', ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'', and ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics A2: Grimoire of the Rift]]''. In ''Final Fantasy XII'', normal [[magicite|skystones]] lose their effect when in jagd territory, making it impossible for [[Airship (term)|airships]] that run on skystones to cross it.

In ''Final Fantasy Tactics Advance'', jagds are zones in which [[Judge (Tactics Advance)|judges]] do not appear. As such, there are no [[Law system (Tactics Advance)|laws]] in jagds and the lack of judges also means that characters are able to permanently die, if not revived before the battle's end.

== Appearances ==
=== ''[[Final Fantasy XII]]'' ===
{{See|Sage Knowledge 27-52#SK 38: Jagd}}
Skystones do not work properly when crossing the border into jagds due to the large amount of ambient [[Mist (Final Fantasy XII)|Mist]], as well as the rich amount of [[magicite]] in jagd soil, which interfere with the skystone. No country has been interested in controlling jagds, making them lawless. Some minority races make their societies on jagd terrain, such as [[Urutan-Yensa]] on the sandseas and the [[Baknamy (Final Fantasy XII)|Baknamy]] of the [[Nabreus Deadlands]].

Using manufacted [[nethicite]], the people of [[Archadia]] have made skystones that can fly over jagds and reach areas like the [[Tomb of Raithwall]] and the [[Ridorana Cataract (Final Fantasy XII)|Ridorana Cataract]] by [[Archadian Imperial Fleets|airship]]. The jagd territories seen in the game are:
*[[Jagd Difohr]]
*[[Jagd Naldoa]]
*[[Jagd Ramooda]]
*[[Jagd Yensa]]

=== ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'' ===
[[File:JagdDorsa.png|thumb|200px|A Jagd.]]
Jagds are the three lawless zones: [[Jagd Dorsa]], [[Jagd Ahli]], and [[Jagd Helje]]. Any battle fought at a jagd will not be subjected to the [[Law system (Tactics Advance)|laws]] of Ivalice, and thus heroes do not have to worry about getting [[Yellow Card|yellow card]]s or [[Red Card (Tactics Advance)|red cards]]. Since there is no judge present, any character killed at a jagd who is not resurrected before the battle's end is permanently killed.

The player cannot [[flee]] from a jagd. Because [[Marche Radiuju|Marche]] is the [[clan]] leader, and already forbidden to acquire a red card, if Marche passes away in a jagd, it is [[Game Over (term)|Game Over]]. [[Montblanc]] can die without a Game Over and there will be some dialogue of Marche discovering Montblanc is dead. Montblanc's role will then be filled in by other clan members, typically [[Ezel Berbier|Ezel]].

==== Unlocking requirements ====
Jagds do not necessarily need to be unlocked in this order, as the [[Missions (Tactics Advance)|missions]] needed to unlock them do not necessarily appear in such order.

|After completing "#010 Pale Company", [[Baguba Port]] is placed on the map. Upon landing on Baguba Port, a cutscene occurs. Afterwards, Jagd Dorsa becomes available.
|-

==== Liberating the jagds ====
Despite them being unlocked early enough in the game, jagds are unable to be liberated until after the storyline is completed.

When sending a unit out on a dispatch mission, the conditions for completion is beating 15 enemies. After the completion of the storyline, and unlocking all of the turfs, the time allowed to defend an area drops to 30 days. Since jagds can't be liberated until after the storyline has been completed, they won't ever have a 40 day limit like before.

=== ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics A2: Grimoire of the Rift]]'' ===
Only one jagd is seen in [[Jylland]], [[Zellea, the Forbidden Land]]. Here, the [[Mist (term)|mist]] is strong and unstable, so unstable that rifts have a tendency to open up all the time. These rifts have greatly scarred the landscape.

==Other media==
The Beverage Shop in [[Luxerion]] in ''[[Lightning Returns: Final Fantasy XIII]]'' sells Jagd Frozen Yogurt. Also, there is a forest in the [[Wildlands]] called Jagd Woods with [[Jagd Village]] within.
